ai.councilof.catalog-note.conformance: Level 2 (Discoverable Catalog), exactly. Level 3 (Trusted Catalog) needs a detached JWS over each trust manifest; our signer signs JCS bytes with Ed25519 but does not produce JWS, so no manifest carries a signature and Level 3 is not claimed. Checked by scripts/layer0/ai_catalog.py.
ai.councilof.catalog-note.listing_vs_measurement: Every entry states extensions.ai.councilof.measurement.state. A trustManifest appears only on a MEASURED entry, and its attestation is our signed measurement with the file digest; an UNMEASURED entry is listed, nothing more.
ai.councilof.catalog-note.doctrine: Measurement, not certification. A listing is never adoption.
